Rooms.title: Rooms & suites
Rooms.intro: Explore room types with occupancy, amenities and enquiry options. Live availability is not shown on this website.
Rooms.collectionIntro: Move through quiet interiors, warm natural textures and spaces shaped by the light of Sri Lanka’s southern coast.
Rooms.filmSceneOneBody: Soft morning light, calm interiors and the coast just beyond your room.
Rooms.filmSceneTwoBody: Natural textures and an uncluttered atmosphere create space to properly slow down.
Rooms.filmSceneThreeBody: Step outside, breathe in the warm air and let each day unfold at an easier pace.

Restaurant.title: Restaurant
Restaurant.intro: Menus and dining details will be published after the hotel approves them.
Restaurant.noReservations: Reserve a table or order from the menu on the restaurant page. The bill is paid at the hotel, not online.
Restaurant.filmHeroSupport: Good food. Slow moments. Ocean views.
Restaurant.filmMaterialsBody: Woven ceilings, cane seating and warm timber shape an open, relaxed dining room beside the shore.
Restaurant.filmFlavoursBody: Coastal ingredients, unhurried service and menus you can explore before you arrive.
Restaurant.filmBeachCaption: Dining with the Indian Ocean at arm's length.
Restaurant.filmMenuBody: Browse the menu, reserve a table or look up an existing booking.
Restaurant.filmClosingBody: Slow moments, coastal flavours and the beauty of dining by the ocean.

Reviews.title: Guest reviews
Reviews.intro: Every quote below was written by a guest, reviewed by the hotel, and approved before it was published.
Reviews.lede: Slow mornings, open-air dining and the sound of the ocean — guests often describe Peacock Beach Hotel in quiet, personal words. This page gathers those impressions from people who have stayed with us in Unawatuna, so you can sense the atmosphere before you arrive.
Reviews.howTitle: How reviews appear on this page
Reviews.howBody: We publish only what guests choose to send us here. Nothing is taken from booking platforms, aggregators or marketing materials.
Reviews.howPointOne: After your stay, you may leave a short message with the name you are comfortable showing publicly.
Reviews.howPointTwo: The hotel team reads each submission and decides whether to approve it for this page.
Reviews.howPointThree: Approved reviews stay visible with your display name. Optional ratings are shown when you include them.
Reviews.voicesEmptyNote: When the first reviews are approved, they will appear in this section.
Reviews.faqAnswer: Only reviews submitted through the form on this website and approved by the hotel. We do not display third-party ratings, paid testimonials or unverified quotes.
Reviews.submitLede: If Peacock Beach Hotel was part of your journey along the south coast, we would be grateful for a few honest lines — about the room, the restaurant, the sea air or simply how the days felt.
Reviews.submitSuccess: Thank you. Your review is pending moderation.
Reviews.name: Display name
Reviews.consent: I consent to moderation and publication if approved.
Reviews.submitError: Unable to submit review. Your text is still in the form.

Events.title: Special events & offers
Events.lede: From unhurried season rituals beside the Indian Ocean to occasional celebrations at the hotel, this page lists moments and offers Peacock Beach Hotel chooses to share. Each entry is published by the hotel team when the details are confirmed.
Events.upcomingIntro: Current offers and events that have not yet ended.
Events.pastIntro: Earlier moments, kept here for reference after their end date.
Events.publishTitle: How events appear on this page
Events.publishBody: We show only what the hotel has published here. Titles, dates and descriptions are verified hotel information — not imported from booking sites or social posts.
Events.publishPointOne: The hotel team creates and publishes each event or offer when it is ready to share.
Events.publishPointTwo: Upcoming items remain visible until the listed end date has passed.
Events.publishPointThree: Past events may stay on the page so you can see what has already taken place at the hotel.
Events.emptyFollowUp: When the first offer or event is published, it will appear in the upcoming section below.
Events.enquireBody: For availability, rates or how to take part, contact the hotel directly. Sending a message does not confirm a booking.
